_comment: Worked example of the manifest cag reads. Required: schema, fps, frame_count, playback, view, files. `files` must name exactly one file basenamed motion.json. One thumb per frame under thumbs/ is the pose reference; a partial set is dropped entirely rather than paired wrong. fps and frame_count must agree with motion.json or the bundle is refused. Unknown keys are ignored.
